body.x: MINIROBOT(www.minirobot.co.kr) has been boasting humanoid robot 'ROBONOVA-2' at CES 2012 held in Las Vegas, US, from Jan 10-13th.
Humanoid robot team of 'ROBONOVA-2' received an ovation by dancing to the hot Korean pop of Girls' Generation, 2PM, Brown eyed girls who are leading a Korean wave.

ROBONOVA-2 is a humanoid robot, and students can learn about mechanics & electronics through this robot. Also, People participate robot dance competition or robot Olympic with this robot. In this process, people improve their creativity and logic.

MINIROBOT was established in early 2000 and focused on producing humanoid robot intended for education. Their business is not only limited to education but also engages in government project, display & performance, robot vending machine, and others.

Meanwhile, Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) have prepared exhaustively from prior meeting to on-the-site marketing including finding buyers, market research and others for CES held in Las vegas, US. IITPA has been supporting cracking American market of 8 export promising companies.
